feeds.title: Trees On The Moon Blog
feeds.description: Wedding photographer blog about unique and beautiful weddings we had the privilege to photograph. Check out our latest works here. Trees On The Moon is a collective of wedding photographers & videographers. We consider ourselves lucky to be doing the one thing we love so much - Weddings! Shooting weddings both nationally and internationally for the past 8 years has been a truly amazing time for us.

feeds.title: Andrew Yep Photographie Blog
feeds.description: I am Andrew Yep, a passionate and enthusiastic wedding photographer based in KL. I love capturing moments and telling beautiful stories with my lens. I wrote about the stories I have captured of weddings, pre-weddings and families.

feeds.title: Two Of Us Signature Studio
feeds.description: TWO OF US Signature Studio is an exclusive bridal gallery that caters only to the discerning few with natural, signature rustic & lifestyle concept. We pour in ample love and energy to every single detail - from gown selection to photography & cinematography. We consistently produce exquisite results from our images and custom albums, ensuring that each couple's unique needs and ideas are fulfilled. Browse through our portfolio of photographs, stories of weddings and families and more!

feeds.title: Momento Wedding Blog
feeds.description: Momento Wedding is a Professional Wedding Photographer Penang team. We put our heart and souls to capture you in the most Candid and Natural way. We also love to put a Creative and Artistic touch in your pictures. The blog covers our photographs, tips for better photographs and more!

feeds.title: Digital Camera Malaysia
feeds.description: As the internet becomes more central and relevant to the online entertainment experience, Digital Camera Malaysia is there to provide commentary and advise on new technologies that affect our skillset and the latest trends with video coverage to in-depth reviews, everything about Camera, photography and videography.

feeds.title: Love For Bird And Nature Blog
feeds.description: Explore Birds and Nature Photography in Raub, Malaysia Bird, Backyard birding, Gambar Burung and more! This blog evolved from my personal rambling to my addiction to GPS and Digital Mapping, to Digital SLR cameras and photography in general. Over time this blog focuses more about birds and nature.

feeds.title: Arch & Vow Studio Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news about our latest photography promotion, photography work, wedding planning tips and inspiration. We are professional wedding photographers who like to work with people, and capturing unique emotional moments is our mission. We believe in an approach of prompting rather than posing, so that we can capture organic moments like the raw, candid emotions on display at a wedding.

feeds.title: WLoon Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Wooi Loon. I'm a Destination Wedding Photographer based in Penang, Malaysia, who specializes in Pre Wedding & Actual Day Wedding Photography. My work is an expression of what I am most passionate about storytelling, simplicity and human interaction. Check out some of my recent works for weddings, family photography and more in the blog.

feeds.title: Edwin Tan Photography Blog
feeds.description: Edwin Tan is a Malaysia Wedding Photographer. Edwin started his journey of wedding photography at end of the year 2007. His relaxed and easy-going nature puts couples at ease which enables them to fully express themselves. Edwin is unobtrusive and allows the events to unfold, as they should whilst surreptitiously injecting some of his own direction. With a storyline crafted in his mind, Edwin goes out to find the deeply emotional moments that reflect the story of the day. Check out his work - beautifully crafted stories through his photographs in the blog.

feeds.title: Ameirfikri Blog
feeds.description: Explore our clients' love through these beautifully captured moments on our blog. Ameirfikri is a Malaysian-Based Destination Wedding Photographer, awarded as Rangefinder's 30 Rising Stars 2019, specializing in Destination Wedding & Adventure Session.

feeds.title: Hellojanelee Blog
feeds.description: Jane is a self-taught photographer and now works full-time as a solo wedding photographer. Her photographs are all about the organic, intangible moments that mostly attract non-traditional & creative individuals who share an appreciation for interesting surroundings, laughter and quiet moments. Explore her work, photography tips, inspiration and more!

feeds.title: Vivacious Real Passionate Blog
feeds.description: The blog is a collection of Cinematic Destination wedding visual stories by Vinoth Raj Pillai. Vinoth is Kuala Lumpur-based destination wedding photographer. From your first date to the moment you first see each other as husband and wife on your wedding day, he will capture it all.

feeds.title: Redhu Malek Blog
feeds.description: Redhu Malek Photography & Videography was established in 2008 with a group of talented photographers and videographers. Since then, the business has grown and expanded and now our team is available to cover all areas of photography and videography throughout the Malaysia, Brunei and Singapore. Check out the wedding stories, announcements, updates and more!

feeds.title: Daniel Ooi Fine Art Gallery
feeds.description: The Most Unique Photography Studio In Town. The images we capture will be in your family for hundreds of years, handed down from generation to generation. We are a professional wedding & portrait photography studio located in Johor Bahru. We provide Wedding Day, Pre-wedding, Newborn, Baby, Maternity, Graduation Portrait & Family Portrait. Explore our portfolio, stories behind photographs, announcements and more!

feeds.title: Maxtography Blog
feeds.description: Thomas Tam works to tailor to individual needs by capturing the most fleeting romance into memories of lane through the lens of his camera. His creative skills in presenting his very own uniqueness and style also draw exquisite attention to details and perspective in his candid shots. This is a compilation album for some of my favourite works capturing multicultural and multiethnic weddings and also marks almost 8 years in wedding photography industry.

feeds.title: Alohomora Pictures Blog
feeds.description: ALOHOMORA PICTURES

feeds.title: Memories Blog
feeds.description: Explore all the love stories, inspiration with our photographs and articles. I am Chris Chan. I am just an ordinary guy very passionate in photography and cherish love between couple and family.

feeds.title: Malaysian Wildlife Photography Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a photographic and observational journey through the Natural History of Malaysia. Graeme practised as a pharmacist in Dunedin, Napier and Hamilton after obtaining a degree in pharmacy. Nature photography has always been an interest but was taken up seriously in the last 15 years and he has won over 1200 awards in International exhibitions as well as 30 cover pictures and a number of published articles and images.

feeds.title: Stories Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: We are a team of passionate photographers and videographers in Malaysia who love capturing emotions and moments for couples and families. Let us give you some photography tips on how to get natural expressions of your child in a beautiful way or capturing the perfect picture of your weddings and engagement in our blog.

feeds.title: Alan Leong Photography Blog
feeds.description: Wedding Photographer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Specialized in Actual Day, Pre-wedding, Family Portrait & Event Photography. Established in 2010, Alan Leong is inspired by many to capture the best and most memorable moments for his client that last forever. He believes the key element of photos is to capture the moments, happiness and story behind them. The blog features Alan's best captures of wedding moments, portraits, candids and more!

feeds.title: Cliff Choong Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am Cliff Choong - Malaysia, KL Wedding & Portrait Photographer. This is where I share my works with those who are interested in Authentic, Genuine, Natural, Love photos. I will update my blog from time to time. So, you are always welcome to come back and check my works out anytime.
